summary: All three requirements appear to be implemented. REQ-1 is addressed in CustomMapView.tsx with MAX_ZOOM=19 constant and clamping logic. REQ-2 is addressed in useMapTiles.ts with defensive guards, NaN/Infinity checks, and zoom clamping to MAX_ZOOM_LEVEL=19. REQ-3 is addressed in useMapTransform.ts with MAX_ZOOM=19, sanitizeTransform clamping, isAtMaxZoom/isAtMinZoom flags, and the zoomIn/zoomOut callbacks respecting bounds. The zoom-in button disable state (isAtMaxZoom) is also returned and used in CustomMapView.tsx.
